name: Rozália Görög — a daughter Veronika baptised 1871 at Kiskunfélegyháza
researcher_question: Who were the children of Rozália Görög (born about 1860, died 30 October 1916 at Kecskemét) and her husband János Tarjányi of Kiskunfélegyháza, Pest-Pilis-Solt-Kiskun, Hungary?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 16, hint-samples.csv row 471, flags adds_daughter, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from an 1871 Kiskunfélegyháza Catholic baptism of Veronika Tarjanyi, daughter of Janos Tarjanyi and Rozalia Bona; unverified. The mother's surname differs and the subject was about eleven in 1871, so a false match is the likely outcome.
